rules.description: Cache public static HTML using the origin's short CDN TTL
rules.expression: http.host eq "bunkmeter.online" and http.request.scheme eq "https" and http.request.method eq "GET" and http.request.uri.query eq "" and http.request.uri.path in {"/" "/vtu" "/aktu" "/du" "/attendance-calculator-guide" "/about" "/contact" "/privacy-policy" "/terms" "/disclaimer"}
